text: Cova is an AI interior design platform that takes a photo of your room, runs it through a Bayesian style quiz, and generates a photorealistic AI redesign using FLUX — all in a React Native mobile app backed by a Python pipeline on Modal and Supabase. The standout is the shoppable shelf with SAM pixel-accurate masks, where you can tap any item in the render and shop for it via Google Lens and a DINOv3 re-ranking ensemble.
